notes: Measured 2026-09-14 on the project's own CPU runtime: the karaoke MelBand RoFormer takes 728 s for a 30 s clip (24x realtime), which is about 97 minutes for a four-minute song, against 3 minutes for HTDemucs. Every RoFormer model sits in the same band because the cost comes from the transformer's sequence length rather than the checkpoint size, so none of them is offered on the CPU runtime -- they are shown disabled with the reason instead of being hidden.

dropped_categories.general: General-purpose vocal models; same two-stem vocal/instrumental effect as the vocals category.
dropped_categories.instvoc: Dual vocal+instrumental output; the vocals and instrumental representatives already cover both stems.

models.effect: bleed suppression rather than noise removal
